intro.text: A nobleman in Luthadel, Lord Yestal Haught.

items.text: At a ball at Keep Venture he turned cold toward Valette Renoux, ignoring her when she joined his group and then excusing himself and Triss for their meal. Valette wondered whether her clash with Shan Elariel was to blame, but Sazed thought nobles simply didn't want to waste what might be the last ball for a long while on neutral parties.
